title: Impasses Panel decisions
blurb: Every decision on the Federal Service Impasses Panel's listing, 1988 to 2025, with full text.

joins.sql: SELECT html_url, text_status, text_source, text_chars, text FROM {file} WHERE "table" = 'fsip'

covers: One row per decision on the Federal Service Impasses Panel's listing on flra.gov: 1,071 decisions, 1988-09-16 to 2025-01-15 (the newest on the listing). Listing read 2026-11-08, both sort orders, deduplicated by decision page. Text built 2026-11-16. Unofficial copy; not updated daily yet.
caveats: 108 decisions have no text (Text = empty), mostly 1988 to 2018: the page is title-only and the PDF is a scan with no text layer. Search won't find them; open the PDF.
4 decisions take their text from the PDF (Text = ok_pdf).
Many pages from 2009 on leave out the caption, so the case number and parties may not be in the text.
The listing names parties for only 14 decisions.

columns.label: Case number in PDF name
columns.help: Read from the PDF's file name. It sometimes differs from the listed case number.

columns.label: Text
columns.help: ok: from the decision's flra.gov page. ok_pdf: from the PDF, because the page has no body, is cut off or shows a different decision. partial: the page is cut off and there is no PDF text. empty: the page is title-only and the PDF is a scan with no text layer.

text.label: Decision text (from FLRA's page, or the PDF when Text from is pdf; check flra.gov before quoting)
